name: opencode-zg-embed-auth
description: Magpie/OpenCode provider plugin: routes every embedding name zvec-grep (zg) hardcodes to one configured upstream model (Bailian/DashScope flash by default), with protocol auto-adaptation.

magpie.name: 百炼 zg Embedding

summary.en: Routes all of zg's hardcoded embedding names to one configured upstream model (Bailian flash by default).
summary.zh: 把 zg 写死的全部 embedding 名统一路由到你配置的一个上游模型（默认百炼 flash）。
